title: Fix AttributeError: 'GitHub' object has no attribute 'with_installation'
description:
The GitHub client in `app/infra/github_client.py` is trying to call `self._client.with_installation(event.installation_id)` but the GitHub object doesn't have this method. This is causing 500 Internal Server Errors when processing webhook events.

Traceback:
```
File "/Users/trly/src/github.com/trly/github-action-triage/src/github_action_triage/app/infra/github_client.py", line 22, in fetch_failure_context
    installation_client = self._client.with_installation(event.installation_id)
AttributeError: 'GitHub' object has no attribute 'with_installation'
```

Need to investigate the correct GitHub client API method for creating installation clients.

title: GitHub authentication fails with 403 Forbidden when downloading job logs
description: RequestFailed: Response(403 Forbidden) occurs in github_client.py when calling async_download_job_logs_for_workflow_run. Need to investigate authentication setup and private key handling.
